_: The folders Business-Wrap creates and the icon each ROLE has (0.17.4, owner note of 2026-11-04). Source of truth for assets/icons/build_folder_icons.py (the art), engine/brand-icons.mjs (which role a path has) and the editor's folder lists. Same family as the file icons: navy folder back, a front panel in the role's own colour, one white Lucide-style glyph (ISC). White on the colour must clear 4.5:1 (the builder asserts it); 'root' keeps the brand folder (band front, paper and gold lines).
